title.value: Learning to Navigate the Synthetically Accessible Chemical Space Using Reinforcement Learning
title.justification: The title of the paper is provided at the beginning of the research paper document in a formatted heading.
title.quote: L EARNING T O N AVIGATE T HE S YNTHETICALLY A CCESSIBLE C HEMICAL S PACE U SING R EINFORCEMENT L EARNING

analysis.description: This paper presents a novel forward synthesis framework powered by reinforcement learning for drug design, introducing the Policy Gradient for Forward Synthesis (PGFS) model. The framework addresses the challenge of synthetic accessibility in deep generative models for de novo drug design by embedding synthetic feasibility directly into the drug design system. The paper demonstrates state-of-the-art performance with PGFS in generating drug-like molecular structures, validated through in-silico experiments on HIV targets.

type.justification: The paper involves empirical research demonstrated through the application of a new reinforcement learning model, PGFS, to drug design and the comparison of its performance with other models.
type.quote: In this work, we propose a novel forward synthesis framework powered by reinforcement learning (RL) for de novo drug design... Moreover, we validate PGFS in an in-silico proof-of-concept associated with three HIV targets.
